## Description

Select historically similar assets; trade when their price ratio or normalized spread diverges from its historical range.

## Where it may fit

Stable relative valuation and temporary divergences that later converge.

## Vehicles

Market-neutral equity funds; sector ETFs; highly related futures/FX pairs.

## Required data

Synchronized price history, pair-selection universe, hedge ratio/spread, borrow availability, costs.

## Caveats

Correlation alone is insufficient; structural breaks and legging/slippage risk are significant.
